items.title: Bind the powered campaign protocol to the Tier-C parent plan
items.context: Update the parent Tier-C cross-host quorum execution plan so M4 points to the new powered independent-host campaign protocol as the protocol source of truth, while preserving the no-results/no-paper-change boundary.
items.userSees: The Tier-C parent plan visibly names the powered campaign protocol file and says it is protocol-only, not result evidence.

happy.desc: Parent plan links to tier-c-powered-independent-host-campaign-protocol.md as the M4 protocol source.

edge.desc: Parent plan states the protocol does not change paper numbers or runtime gates by itself.

adversarial.desc: Parent plan does not claim powered Tier-C results have already been produced.

items.title: Commit the powered protocol artifact with explicit claim boundaries
items.context: Keep the new protocol document as a draft protocol artifact defining coverage matrix, adoption boundary, claim boundary, pre-registered questions, independence requirements, and missing pre-campaign work.
items.userSees: The new protocol document clearly separates future powered campaign prerequisites from current evidence and product behavior.

happy.desc: Protocol document includes coverage matrix, adoption boundary, claim boundary, pre-registered questions, and independence requirements.

edge.desc: Protocol document says it is not an experiment result and does not alter runtime gates, story DONE gates, paper numbers, playbook guidance, or release wording.

adversarial.desc: Protocol document keeps missing items such as multi-key signed verdicts, protocol.lock.json, records-tier-c.jsonl, and independent recompute as future prerequisites.
